title: Chips and Cheese Interviews AMD’s Mike Clark on Zen 6
summary: Chips and Cheese has published an in-depth interview with AMD’s Mike Clark about Zen 6, aimed at hardware and systems readers who follow CPU architecture. The item is presented as a technical conversation with an AMD designer, not as a product launch or specification disclosure. The supplied material does not include Zen 6 core configurations, process node, performance claims, compatibility details, or a release date.
